svg.aria-label: Diffusion over the pose space of a peptide: the product space R3 x SO(3) x T^m, the four noise kernels at three times, the noise schedule and diffusion coefficient over the 16 steps, and one reverse trajectory with the dihedral distributions at each step.
svg.text: m rotatable torsions, noised separately for backbone and side chain
Four noise kernels at three times (σ(t) = σ_min^(1−t) · σ_max^t)
Noise schedule and diffusion coefficient over the 16 reverse steps
diffusion time t (t = 1 noise → t = 0 pose)
open circles: the 16 steps, t_k = 1 − k/16
x ← x + g²·Δt·s_θ + g·√Δt·z with Δt = 1/16
One reverse trajectory: HybriDock-Pep denoises the p53 peptide onto MDM2 (PDB 1YCR)
Histograms are the forward-process marginals on the 11 φ, 11 ψ and 12 ω dihedrals of the 1YCR p53 peptide; snapshots are an illustration of one trajectory.
